title: MoralResponse
description: Raw data entity representing a single moral dilemma response from the Moral Machine dataset.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the response location.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the response location.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp of the response.

country.description: Country code or name associated with the response.

dilemma_id.description: Unique identifier for the specific dilemma scenario.
